source.name: IEC Common Data Dictionary local cache
source.notes: This file is a complete local IEC CDD cache for the project's available data: curated seed records, optional files under repositories/iec_cdd_dictionary/imports, and every IEC 61360 IRDI/ConceptDescription referenced by the checked-in IDTA Submodel Templates. IEC does not provide a simple anonymous bulk JSON endpoint for the full public CDD, so official exports should be placed in imports/ and this script rerun.
